lena.marketing: quick post-webinar note  saw ~1.7% of leads not picked up by RR when our enrichment endpoint lagged. SDRs reported manual claims spike this morning.
jamal.ops: thanks, can you attach an example request id? is this the TTL handshake expiring or a webhook retry edge? :mag_right: 
lena.marketing: pasted sample in #alerts earlier but short repro: HS webhook accepted -> enrich svc returns 202 with progress header -> router TTL=6s -> we currently don't honor in-progress so it falls back to FailoverQueue. SDRs only poll RR.
mike.salesops: ugly. Two options: 1) change HS workflow to defer for enrich and route to a HoldQueue, or 2) router does a lightweight enrich-probe and extends TTL when service says "in-progress". ops prefers router-side probe to avoid workflow churn.
jamal.ops: agree probe is lower friction. small change: on webhook receipt router does GET /enrich/status/{lead_id}, if response 202 + header X-Enrich-ETA-ms we add min(ETA,30000) to TTL and re-evaluate. add metric enrich_probe_extend_count.
olivia.eng: I can implement probe behavior today as a feature flag. Implementation notes: - probe on receipt with 50ms timeout - if 200 && done -> route immediately - if 202 && ETA present -> extend handshake ttl by min(ETA,30s) - otherwise follow existing path. will open PR to routing-service.
raj.sdr: will SDR inbox be noisy while lead waits? we need hide the ones being probed. please set owner=unassigned for probed leads.
mike.salesops: will update HS to include property `owner=unassigned` for campaign webhooks. also add a small tag `routing_probe=true` so we can filter.
jamal.ops: add alerts: if enrich_probe_extend_count / daily_leads > 0.5% raise P1. also track manual_claims_per_hour and set baseline.
olivia.eng: timeline: PR up in 2h, review + canary tonight 10:00 PT behind feature flag `enrich_probe_extend`. router-bot please schedule canary.
router-bot: deploy queued: enrich-probe-extend by olivia.eng  status pending. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
lena.marketing: thanks. add playbook note: "If router_probe holds a lead, expect up to 30s delay before assignment; SDRs should not manually claim unless property `enrich_state=done` or >15m hold."
mike.salesops: also adding a fallback: if lead remains unassigned >10m send digest to SDR team. raj, want to own digest recipients?
raj.sdr: happy to. prefer 10m digest and hourly summary.
jamal.ops: post-canary we run a 1% synthetic load where enrichment deliberately delays to validate manual_claims delta and backfill behavior. rollback if manual claims increase.
olivia.eng: will include canary dashboard: enrich_probe_hits, probe_extend_ms histogram, held_to_rr_count. thanks team.
lena.marketing: great  we'll monitor KPIs after canary and update the webinar playbook with the TTL probe mitigation.
